mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, parent_id AS parentId, enabled, sort FROM sys_dept WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT ud.id, ud.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, ud.dept_id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName, d.type AS deptType, ud.is_primary AS isPrimary, ud.create_op AS createOp, ud.create_time AS createTime, ud.modify_op AS modifyOp, ud.modify_time AS modifyTime FROM sys_user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON ud.dept_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ud.deleted = 0 AND ud.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.create_time ASC
